constraints: Probe must run on a different machine with no install and no network
Probe must never write to a field .twining/ store
Thresholds must be fixed before first field run to keep the result falsifiable
context: Built read-only field probe + pre-registered validation doc; dogfood baseline already refutes the review's strongest capture claim
rationale: the dogfood repo is the best case for gate compliance, so a field store scoring better on any row is itself a signal worth noticing
summary: Chose to publish the dogfood baseline alongside the field instructions rather than only the thresholds
